extracted.intended_audience: general readers and Wikipedia editors (those reading or contributing to celebrity biographies)
extracted.subtask_description: An encyclopedic Wikipedia biography of a living celebrity (here: Steve Harvey). The page is authored to conform to Wikipedia's content policies and style conventions (BLP/sourcing, language variety, date format) and shows maintenance tags for unsourced material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wikipedia indefinitely semi-protected biographies of living people
rubrics_metrics.description: Hidden category on the page indicating it is a biography of a living person that is indefinitely semi-protected.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Biographies of living persons (BLP) must follow strict sourcing and libel-avoidance policies: contentious or potentially libelous material about living persons requires high-quality, reliable sources; unsourced or poorly sourced negative material must be removed. Semi-protection is a procedural measure that limits editing to registered/autoconfirmed users to reduce vandalism and protect BLP content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use American English from November 2025
rubrics_metrics.description: Hidden category indicating the article uses American English and is maintained under that language variety policy (noted as 'Use American English from November 2025').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Articles tagged to use a specific variety of English should consistently use that variety's spelling, grammar, and usage (e.g., American spelling and conventions) throughout the article to maintain stylistic consistency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use mdy dates from September 2015
rubrics_metrics.description: Hidden category indicating the article uses month–day–year (MDY) date formatting since September 2015.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contributors should format dates in the article consistently using MDY (e.g., January 17, 1957) when the article is tagged to follow that convention.

rubrics_metrics.name: All articles with unsourced statements / Articles with unsourced statements from October 2019
rubrics_metrics.description: Hidden categories and inline markers ([citation needed]) show that parts of the article contain unsourced statements and have been flagged for lacking citations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statements marked with 'citation needed' or placed into 'articles with unsourced statements' categories should be supported by reliable sources or removed. This is a maintenance/evaluation criterion: presence of many unsourced statements indicates weaker article quality and triggers editorial action to add citations or verify claims.
